title: Set Operations
description: Combining result sets from multiple queries using UNION, EXCEPT, and INTERSECT.
longDescription: This module covers set operators in SQL Server. You'll learn how to combine result sets from multiple queries using UNION, find differences with EXCEPT, and find intersections with INTERSECT.
whatYouLearn: Combine result sets using UNION and UNION ALL
Find common rows between queries using INTERSECT
Find differences between queries using EXCEPT
Understand set operator rules and requirements
